_comment: Market Timing series, all FREE (FRED keyless CSV, verified live 2026-08-19). layer = leading|coincident|lagging (lagging kept ONLY as confirmation, never a signal). geo: national, or Charlotte CBSA 16740 / BLS metro code 737 -- swap those ids for another metro. rising_read = what an UPWARD move means for a distressed-acquisition buyer (sourcing vs exit). This model answers WHEN/WHERE; the Owner Distress Score answers WHAT/WHO -- kept separate on purpose.

series.label: 10-Year Treasury yield
series.rising_read: financing cost up -> affordability pressure + more motivated sellers; hard-money pricing up

series.label: 30Y fixed mortgage rate
series.rising_read: buyer pool shrinks, prices soften -> better acquisition, harder exit/refi

series.label: SLOOS: net % banks tightening CRE standards
series.rising_read: local lending window closing -> fewer competing buyers, but your own debt harder

series.label: Housing permits (national, SAAR)
series.rising_read: future supply ~12-24mo out -> caution on appreciation plays

series.label: Charlotte metro building permits
series.rising_read: LOCAL future supply -> the one that matters for your submarkets

series.label: Single-family mortgage delinquency (banks)
series.rising_read: borrower stress rising -> more distressed inventory (good sourcing, softening market)

series.label: CRE loan delinquency (banks)
series.rising_read: CRE distress rising -> forced-sale supply (the maturity-wall mechanism showing up)

series.label: Rental vacancy rate
series.rising_read: softening rental demand -> concession risk, NOI pressure

series.label: Charlotte metro nonfarm employment (000s)
series.rising_read: job growth -> housing demand (feeds jobs-to-permits ratio)

series.label: Charlotte house price index
series.rising_read: CONFIRMATION ONLY -- prices are a lagging index, never a signal

derived.name: mortgage_spread
derived.read: lender risk appetite. Widening = credit tightening / risk-off (also drives hard-money pricing); narrowing = easing.

derived.name: jobs_to_permits
derived.formula: (12mo change in CHAR737NA*1000) / (12mo sum of CHAR737BPPRIV)
derived.read: ~1.2-1.5 balanced; <1.0 signals local oversupply; high = undersupply / demand outrunning building.
